title: CollageMaker LLM report regeneration + session-timeline enrichment
outcome: Regenerated the CollageMaker LLM usage report (HTML + JSON) for the full project history (Jul 1 - Aug 4, 2026, 517 sessions) and added a new 'Session Timeline — How Tokens Were Used Over Time' section that cross-references 233 session summaries from _agent_docs/project-timeline/sessions/ with daily token data: 5 phase cards with token shares, a 35-day day-by-day table (tokens, sessions, summaries, commits, agent mix, narrative), and 5 observed usage patterns.
key_decisions: Used the full project path as --project filter so only /Users/austin/workspace/austin183.github.io/CollageMaker matches (the DB also contains /Users/austin/workspace/CollageMaker with 206 sessions and .../Experiments/CollageMaker with 741 sessions; a bare 'CollageMaker' substring would mix all three)

Full history equals the directory's lifetime (first session 2026-07-01, last 2026-08-04); no sessions exist after Aug 4, so data matches the Aug 5 report exactly (517 sessions, 717.7M raw, 48.1M effective, 94.2% cache)
Added the timeline as a post-processed HTML section between 'Charts & Visualizations' and 'Cost Analysis' — one-off enrichment script, no changes to the report generator or production scripts

Phase boundaries defined from session content, not dates alone: Greenfield (Jun 30-Jul 5, 33.3% of tokens), Stabilization & CRs (Jul 6-12, 23.1%), Title & UX (Jul 13-19, 16.7%), Undo/Redo & Mobile (Jul 20-26, 14.4%), Mobile Polish & Multi-Touch (Jul 27-Aug 3, 12.5%)

Added a 2026-08-02 row with 0 tokens: two summaries exist for that date but the DB records no sessions under it (matching work is timestamped Aug 3) — kept the daily table complete and explained the gap inline
Overwrote the existing BlogPosts/references/CollageMaker-LLM-Report.html in place and wrote the JSON payload alongside it
learnings: The current render_consolidated_report.py substitutes the project name correctly — the Aug 5 file still showed the '[ProjectName]' placeholder, the regenerated file shows 'CollageMaker'
Summary file dates and DB timestamps can diverge: 2026-08-02 has 2 summaries but zero DB sessions for the day (work recorded under Aug 3)
One session summary file (2026-07-13-009-build-tdd-sidebar-reorder-autexpand.json) is malformed JSON — 'session_number': 009 (leading zero); parsing needs a regex fallback for leading-zero integers

233 of 517 sessions have written summaries; only build-* and plan-bdd agents write them, so summary counts are a floor for daily activity (subagent runs like world-review/explore/diff-review are never summarized)
Token intensity decayed across the project: 5.3M effective tokens/day at the greenfield peak (Jul 5) down to ~0.6-0.9M/day in the polish weeks (Jul 27 - Aug 3)

validate_summaries.sh is out of sync with references/session-summary.json: it globs only '*-summary.json' files and checks a legacy field set (session_number, files_changed, test_files_added, bugs_fixed, ...) that the current template does not define — kit session files (YYYY-MM-DD-NNN-*.json) are invisible to it. Direct field comparison against the template is the working validation until the script is updated
next_steps: Commit the regenerated report + JSON (build-quick-work responsibility)
Consider making the session-timeline section a first-class feature of render_consolidated_report.py (would need a sessions-dir input and phase definitions)
Fix the malformed summary file 2026-07-13-009 (leading-zero session_number) in the CollageMaker project
Sync validate_summaries.sh with references/session-summary.json (glob pattern + required field list) so kit session files are actually validated
